children: Meta Platforms Inc. (META, Financials), owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, is planning to increase the usage of its in-house-designed AI chips as it attempts to reduce the cost of its vast infrastructure buildout.
The decision is noteworthy as computing is one of the key expense drivers in the AI race.
Meta has invested billions in data centers, servers and accelerators as it builds ever more sophisticated models and rolls out AI features across its platforms.
If Meta did more chip design in-house, it could get another lever. Custom silicon can be tuned around particular workloads, and not a wide range of tasks expected from general purpose accelerators.
That would make it cheaper and more efficient to run AI services at massive scale. That is also strategically advantageous.
More internal chips would lower Meta's reliance on outside semiconductor providers for some tasks, even as sophisticated Nvidia accelerators remain core to the company's infrastructure.
The move is part of a wider trend among hyperscalers like Google and Amazon that have developed specialized processors for AI and cloud computing.
Meta's next test is whether those chips can provide considerable savings as its AI infrastructure spending keeps growing.

title: Meta is making a bigger AI chip move to cut costs
